title: 38_143685_box7_Incident_Summaries_1-100
doc_notes: This document is a collection of incident summaries regarding unidentified flying objects, containing multiple firsthand and corroborated encounter reports.

encounters.summary: Major J. C. Wise observed a yellowish-white spherical object, 5-10 feet in diameter, oscillating in a forward whirling movement.
encounters.entity_behavior: oscillating in a forward whirling movement
encounters.quote: oscillating in a forward whirling movement without losing altitude

encounters.summary: Captain John Paul Strapp observed a silvery, ovular object with two projections on the upper surface, suggesting rotation or oscillation.
encounters.entity_appearance: silvery, ovular, two projections on upper surface
encounters.quote: presented a distinct ovular outline, with two (2) projections on the upper surface

encounters.summary: Kenneth Arnold observed a chain of 9 mirror-like, circular craft flying in a diagonal chain-like line.
encounters.entity_behavior: swerved in and out of high mountain peaks

encounters.summary: Capt. E. J. Smith and crew observed nine flying discs near Emmett, Idaho, described as thin and smooth on the bottom and rough on top.
encounters.entity_appearance: thin and smooth on bottom, rough on top
encounters.quote: thin and smooth on the bottom and rough appearing on top

encounters.summary: Capt. Thomas F. Mantell and other observers tracked a large, metallic, circular object that climbed and moved at high speed.
